body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Epson introduced 'EX71', its multimedia projector designed to provide entrepreneurs and businesses with convenience, advanced features and reliability at an affordable price at CES 2010.

Available at leading retail outlets such as Best Buy, OfficeMax, Staples, and Amazon.com, the Epson EX71 ($749) offers Epson's latest, 3LCD, 3-chip technology for vibrant, true-to-life images and easy to use performance features, including USB Plug 'n Play connectivity that instantly displays images and audio on both the projector and computer screen by simply connecting a USB cable.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
